title: The Museum Mix-Up Prank
intro: After hours at the museum, someone swapped the gala's fancy display labels and painted a mustache on the star exhibit, ruining the opening night reveal.

suspects.name: Ada
suspects.line: Labels were perfect when I left. Perfect, I tell you.

suspects.name: Theo
suspects.line: Fixing the lights all evening. Nobody noticed me, as usual.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: I was checking the guest list in the gift shop. Twice.

suspects.name: Marisol
suspects.line: I was sketching the dinosaurs. Ask anyone who was there.

suspects.name: Gus
suspects.line: Gala? I only came for the free cookies, honestly.

clues.text: The culprit is not the one holding a clipboard, because the guest clipboard was still on the desk with its sign-in sheet untouched all evening.
The culprit is not the one in the paint-splattered smock, as the coat check shows that smock was returned clean and hung up before the mustache appeared.
The culprit is not the one carrying a toolbox, since the toolbox never left the closet and was found with every tray still latched shut.
The culprit was last seen heading into the east wing, where the camera caught a figure slipping past the velvet rope just before the lights went down.
